BETA Close X The Sage Group PLC has purchased 602,097 of its ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange and multilateral trading facilities from J.P. Morgan Securities plc, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The purchases occurred on May 5, 2026, with the highest price paid per share being 915.4000 pence and the lowest at 887.0000 pence, resulting in a volume-weighted average price of 900.0131 pence per share. Sage intends to cancel all acquired shares. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 05 May 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 4 / 77 pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from J.P. Morgan Securities plc (''JPMS''). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 which is expected to end no later than 5 June 2026.
